userConfirmedExecutionRule: 允许：缺必要证据即暂缓，证据齐备者完成六步审核
meaning: Every enumerated candidate receives a recorded gate disposition. Missing admissible formal evaluation or major-AI-contribution evidence can stop this round before full-text review. Such a stop is deferred/needs-evidence, not academic rejection or removal from the collection pool.
prohibitions: Do not call a lookup miss proof that no award exists
Do not label every item semantically reviewed
Do not count deferred items as all six steps completed
Do not infer major impact from author abstracts or award labels alone
cutoff: Public metadata available on 2026-09-23; first-submission date in 2026. Unannounced submissions and future publications are not observable.
publication: Experiment only; no automatic website publication or deletion.
